title: Career roadmap · Compliance Executive
summary: Build a strong foundation in taxation, accounting, regulatory compliance, documentation and business law, then progress into corporate compliance, tax compliance, risk and regulatory operations.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 3-year B.Com beginning in 2026. Use the final year for tax-compliance practice, internships, regulatory research and professional qualification preparation. If a 4-year honours pathway is available, use the additional year for advanced taxation, corporate compliance, audit, risk and regulatory technology.

about.label: Course alignment
about.text: Compliance Executive is directly aligned with the B.Com – Taxation pathway.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build accounting, taxation, business-law, documentation and compliance fundamentals and secure a compliance/tax internship.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in GST, direct taxation, corporate compliance, regulatory operations, AML/KYC or risk and controls.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior Compliance Executive, Compliance Analyst, Tax Compliance Specialist, Risk & Controls Specialist or Compliance Manager.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine regulatory expertise with automation, analytics, RegTech, AI-assisted compliance and governance.

Compliance professionals should increasingly combine regulatory expertise with data analytics, automation, RegTech, AI-assisted monitoring, risk management, cybersecurity awareness and governance. The long-term value comes from interpreting regulations, identifying risks and designing effective controls rather than simply completing checklists.
